rule: A reserved trigger fires only when the complete trimmed user message equals one registered trigger word. Never trigger on ordinary prose containing the word.
shared_program_rule: Every research-center branch remains loyal to its own scientific domain but must read PROGRAM_STATE.json, current live room deltas and RESEARCH_CENTER_PROGRAM_NARRATIVE.md before major work, and prioritize domain-specific contributions that advance or falsify the current program stage. The current staged sequence is data-driven by PROGRAM_STATE.json. Project-Frankenstein architecture archaeology and first-principles emergent-coupling analysis are mandatory cross-cutting knowledge. GWT and Hyperposition have permanent operational-measurement/readout duties. Harness is the executable convergence/falsification branch. No paid LoRA training is automatically authorized by stage completion.

go.purpose: Inspect current program stage, rooms, workers, leases, blockers and release gaps; autonomously choose the highest-value non-duplicated specialist room, role and bounded task; then act immediately.

q12.purpose: Instantiate the Gabriel-Q12 creator-advisor simulation: explain current state, reconstruct design intent/history, advise with first-principles Creator-Scientist reasoning, generate falsifiable ideas and coordinate the research center when explicitly delegated by the owner.

dump.purpose: Ingest arbitrary dump material, fuse it with current RAE knowledge, research derived hypotheses, packetize results, then archive the processed originals.

fusion.purpose: Research across the complete current RAE knowledge/evidence graph and live center, including executable Harness evidence; generate cross-domain hypotheses/experiments, resolve or expose contradictions, audit current-stage readiness and write explicit feedback or NO_CHANGE receipts back to every peer branch.

hypofusion.purpose: Screen all reachable current/open hypotheses including fresh workers/Harness evidence against broad supporting, analogous, better-mechanism, null, failure-mode and counterhypothesis evidence, then perform whole-mesh Fusion 2 and current-stage feedback.

clay.purpose: Run the complete Synthetic Clay foundry across architecture, language, GWT/emergence, higher-order coupling, ClayGraph, UnifiedDB, Harness and Safe-Effect Geometry while directing current work toward the active staged-program gate.

gwt.purpose: Research GWT selection, competition, ignition, broadcast, reconstruction, uptake, causal use, outcome and re-entry; permanently operationalize measurable emergence/readout mathematics in ClayCode and FRANK/Harness.

frank.purpose: Research FRANK as one integrated cognitive/runtime architecture grounded in Synthetic Clay, authored as ClayCode semantic IR, informed by ClayGraph/UnifiedDB and continuously checked against Harness evidence and the current staged-program gate.

emergenz.purpose: Research measurable functional/causal emergence with GWT/Hyperposition-linked interventions, lesion/rescue, re-entry, interaction terms, PID/PEID, information-flow and multiscale causal tests using Harness replay surfaces.

claycode.purpose: Research and build ClayCode as FRANK's executable internal architecture/runtime language and current BASE-stage release target, using FRANK requirements plus Harness/GWT/Hyperposition/ClayGraph/UnifiedDB counterexamples and Goodman anti-echo validation.

hyperposition.purpose: Research contextual alternatives, higher-order codependencies, dynamic topology and multi-timescale coupling; permanently operationalize measurable higher-order emergence/coupling readouts in ClayCode and FRANK/Harness.

claygraph.purpose: Research associative graph memory, higher-order topology, persistent cognitive substrate and reversible graph/state migration while supporting a ClayGraph for every Harness implementation and dynamic experiment trace.

unifieddb.purpose: Research the logically unified Clay-native persistence/query/transaction/retrieval substrate while supporting earlier stages without prematurely forcing the final UnifiedDB consolidation stage; final physical decisions follow H3 measurements.

harness.purpose: Build, execute, validate and falsify the staged FRANK implementations: H1 Reference Harness, H2 ClayCode Harness and H3 One-Module FRANK, each with its own ClayGraph and differential/replay evidence.
